questions.questionText: Dart is an open-source programming language developed by which company?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Google.

questions.questionText: Dart is best described as a language that is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Client-centric and open source.

questions.questionText: The dart2js utility generates:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) JavaScript.

questions.questionText: “Platform independent” means Dart can:
options: Need separate code for every OS
Run on Windows, Linux, macOS and other operating systems
questions.correctAnswer: Run on Windows, Linux, macOS and other operating systems
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Run on Windows, Linux, macOS and other operating systems.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is NOT an OOP feature supported by Dart?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Pointer arithmetic.

questions.questionText: The syntax of Dart follows which style?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) C-style syntax.

questions.questionText: The Dart project was started by:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Lars Bak.

questions.questionText: Lars Bak, who started the Dart project, is known for his work on:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Virtual machines.

questions.questionText: Dart was first introduced at the GOTO conference held in:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Aarhus, Denmark.

questions.questionText: Which Ecma International technical board regulates the Dart language?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) TC52.

questions.questionText: The first edition of the Dart language specification was standardized in:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) July 2014.

questions.questionText: The second edition of the Dart specification was approved by Ecma International:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Six months later.

questions.questionText: Which was the initial compiler used for Dart?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) dartc.

questions.questionText: The Frog compiler was discarded because of:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Inefficiency in compiling the code.

questions.questionText: Which compiler is still used in Dart today?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) dart2js.

questions.questionText: What is the correct order of compiler evolution in Dart?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) dartc → Frog → dart2js.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is an inbuilt Dart library?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) dart:core.

questions.questionText: Which statement is used to bring exported Dart code into another application?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) import.

questions.questionText: The Dart Virtual Machine makes Dart:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Platform independent.

questions.questionText: The syntax of Dart is similar to which languages?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) C#, Java and JavaScript.

questions.questionText: Dart is called open source because it is:
options: Available at no cost and free for anyone to use
questions.correctAnswer: Available at no cost and free for anyone to use
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Available at no cost and free for anyone to use.

questions.questionText: What makes it possible for Dart to run on all browsers?
options: Native Dart VM in every browser
Compilation to optimized JavaScript by dart2js
questions.correctAnswer: Compilation to optimized JavaScript by dart2js
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Compilation to optimized JavaScript by dart2js.

questions.questionText: Dart supports multithreading-style concurrency by using:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Isolates.

questions.questionText: Which statement about Dart Isolates is true?
options: They run only on the GPU
They are independent workers that do not share memory
questions.correctAnswer: They are independent workers that do not share memory
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) They are independent workers that do not share memory.

questions.questionText: Isolates communicate with each other by:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Passing serialized messages.

questions.questionText: Which advanced OOP concept is mentioned as supported by Dart?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Mixin.

questions.questionText: The “Type Safe” feature of Dart means:
options: Both static and runtime type checking are performed
questions.correctAnswer: Both static and runtime type checking are performed
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Both static and runtime type checking are performed.

questions.questionText: Dart offers which two kinds of compilation?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) JIT and AOT.

questions.questionText: A JIT compiler converts source code into native machine code:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Just before the program executes.

questions.questionText: AOT compilation is typically used when:
options: The application is ready for deployment (server, App Store, Play Store)
questions.correctAnswer: The application is ready for deployment (server, App Store, Play Store)
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) The application is ready for deployment (server, App Store, Play Store).

questions.questionText: Dart used together with Flutter can build:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Mobile, desktop and web applications.

questions.questionText: The biggest benefit of building apps with Dart and Flutter is:
options: A separate app per device is needed
A single code base works across platforms
questions.correctAnswer: A single code base works across platforms
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) A single code base works across platforms.

questions.questionText: Dart can be used on the back end as a server-side language.
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) True.

questions.questionText: Which Android Studio version is used in the installation steps?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Bumblebee | 2021.1.1 Patch 3.

questions.questionText: Which Dart SDK version is shown in the installation steps?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) 2.16.2.

questions.questionText: After starting the IDE, what must be installed to work with Dart?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Dart plugin.

questions.questionText: After the Dart plugin is installed, you should:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Restart Android Studio.

questions.questionText: If the Dart SDK path value is not visible in the new-project dialog, you should:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Enter the path manually.

questions.questionText: Which command-line package manager can also be used to install Dart?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Chocolatey.

questions.questionText: Basic Dart syntax comprises:
options: Keywords, data types, variables, constants, string literals and symbols
questions.correctAnswer: Keywords, data types, variables, constants, string literals and symbols
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Keywords, data types, variables, constants, string literals and symbols.

questions.questionText: Which function is the entry point of a Dart application?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) main().

questions.questionText: In void main(), the word void means the function:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Returns nothing.

questions.questionText: Which symbol starts a single-line comment in Dart?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) //.

questions.questionText: A comment in Dart is:
options: Code that is not read by the compiler
questions.correctAnswer: Code that is not read by the compiler
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Code that is not read by the compiler.

questions.questionText: Which function prints a string to the console in Dart?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) print().

questions.questionText: Dart is designed to prioritize which development feature?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Sub-second stateful hot reload.

questions.questionText: Which of these is a valid identifier?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) _name.

questions.questionText: Which of these is an invalid identifier?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) 1name.

questions.questionText: Which special characters can an identifier contain?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) $ and _.

questions.questionText: Keywords in Dart are:
options: Reserved, case-sensitive words that cannot be used as names
questions.correctAnswer: Reserved, case-sensitive words that cannot be used as names
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Reserved, case-sensitive words that cannot be used as names.
